note: These are verification tasks, not fixed/closed claims. Closing a task requires named source and execution evidence; broader native/design gaps remain open.

tasks.remaining: Asagiri v0.1.13 ships /grpc, /session and /build for Buildx's docker driver, host-gateway and direct image loading. Linux release CI exercises these paths. Native Mac VM and Windows WSL builder qualification remains open.

All three build products and the corresponding source, including 44 target and host package entries, were independently verified. Source/bundle boundary checks and the xtask compile pass. Native Intel Mac VM execution remains unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #66: bun install aborts under linux/amd64 emulation on Apple Silicon (QEMU SIGABRT), works on OrbStack
tasks.remaining: Actual Rosetta/bun execution requires a native Apple Silicon VM; no Linux emulation substitute proves it.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #72: Bind mounts (macOS): open(O_CREAT|O_WRONLY, 0200) fails with EACCES, breaking Node's native fs.cpSync
tasks.remaining: The patch is retained; native Mac virtiofs/Node fs.cpSync still needs reproduction.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #73: Control Kiri from browser.
tasks.remaining: Implemented a loopback-only, password-protected live browser with bounded container, image, volume, network and log views; start/stop/restart require a separate permission. Private Linux engine and real Chromium checks pass, including authentication, revocation, origins, request limits and deadlines. Native Mac engine and Windows named-pipe execution remain unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #74: Create an MCP server to allow agents to work smoother
tasks.remaining: The local stdio interface passes custom protocol regressions and the official MCP Python SDK 2.3.0 with typed discovery/results, redaction, separately permitted actions and revocation. Native Windows named-pipe clients and real native settings interaction still require execution on target systems.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #85: docker load / import always fail (400): "archive is missing <config>.json" though the file is in the tar — cannot ingest local images
tasks.remaining: docker load, archive-body completion and Docker's rootfs import API have separate production implementations and live tests. Confirm both against the frozen candidate; upstream #461 is a verification task for existing rootfs import support.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #91: Setup failure is undiagnosable: "the test container did not run" hides the real cause
tasks.remaining: Diagnostics have unit coverage; native first-run setup still requires platform execution.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #92: `setup.json` `done:false` leaves Kiri silently dead — no retry, engine never starts
tasks.remaining: Persisted incomplete setup, missing distro, reboot gating, and engine/tools retry have unit coverage; native Windows first-run recovery still requires execution.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #93: After long idle / Windows sleep, `docker` fails with "Kiri is stopped: press Start" and the bridge is not rebuilt
tasks.remaining: Background/window startup and a lost handshaken bridge restore only daemon availability, preserving the persisted engine Stop state. Managed Buildx registration and saved preferences are restored on a separate worker only after an explicit running-state response; stopped, unknown and unavailable engines skip registration. Pure regressions cover explicit wake, a Stop during recovery, serialized startup, failed attempts and bounded retries. Native Windows sleep/wake, WSL disappearance and running-container recovery remain unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #99: Getting issue with DDEV
tasks.remaining: The complete PHP/MariaDB/HTTPS DDEV project has Linux CI coverage, including restart and router configuration replacement. Native macOS VM behavior from the report still needs verification.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #123: macOS: VM data.img retains host disk allocation after guest files are deleted
tasks.remaining: The trim worker is isolated in a child process and has a standalone Linux regression; host allocated-block reclamation still needs a real Mac VM.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #125: Docker network compatibility: bridge options and IPv4/IPv6 drivers
tasks.remaining: Linux coverage passes; native Mac/WSL network parity remains a separate check.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #130: Container security: custom seccomp profiles without weakening Kiri host isolation
tasks.remaining: Linux release CI retains the seccomp compiler, default-profile and runc comparison checks. Overlapping-rule semantics, a complete current Docker allowlist audit and broader production proofs remain separate verification work.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #168: Release or suspend WebView2 memory when window is closed to tray (Lightweight background mode)
tasks.remaining: Hidden WebView2 now requests suspension and resumes on show, preserving the document and terminal state. Native close/reopen race, terminal continuity, and renderer memory measurements remain required.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #170: 请看提交的报告
tasks.remaining: The attached report contains four actionable subreports: LaunchAgent restart policy, bundled kernel discovery, symlinked bind sources, and stale published ports. The #231 port re-resolves linked sources on each start; its pure Mac filesystem regression passes on 44fab19 while retaining lifecycle locks and original inspect paths. Native Mac lifecycle, VM bind restart and published-port reproduction remain unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #187: macOS: window traffic-light buttons shift upward after switching themes
tasks.remaining: Theme changes now reapply native button placement after AppKit layout; pure LTR/RTL geometry regression passes. Switching themes in a native Mac window still requires verification.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #190: Windows: the window's usage figure counts unrelated processes (PID reuse when building the process tree)
tasks.remaining: Portable PID-tree and CPU sample-identity regressions pass; CPU baselines use process creation time on Mac, Linux, and Windows. Native Windows handle sampling remains a Windows CI check.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #199: Every linux/amd64 container crashes with "rosetta error: unhandled auxillary vector type 29" (SIGTRAP) on Apple Silicon
tasks.remaining: Ported upstream #208: omit zero HWCAP3/HWCAP4 auxv entries for older Rosetta. Kernel recipes include the patch; actual macOS 15 Rosetta execution remains unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #202: USB device detaches by itself after ~8 minutes idle (ESP32-S3)
tasks.remaining: USB attachments prevent idle sleep and reconnect by identity while the daemon remains running. Waiting devices are visible and cancelable in API/CLI/UI; reconnect generations and immediate-drop registration are covered by eight passing Mac state tests on 44fab19. Physical ESP32 reset, idle and Mac sleep/wake tests remain unverified; reconnect intent is not persisted across daemon restarts.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #203: Proposal for a Kiri MCP server (As suggested in Issue #74)
tasks.remaining: The local stdio interface passes custom protocol regressions and the official MCP Python SDK 2.3.0 with typed discovery/results, redaction, separately permitted actions and revocation. Native Windows named-pipe clients and real native settings interaction still require execution on target systems.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #209: Windows: docker build hangs when a RUN step needs network (BuildKit has no usable DNS)
tasks.remaining: Default-bridge DNS now uses the reachable bridge gateway whenever a local host resolver needs the agent, including WSL. Local stubs are retained rather than replaced by public resolvers. Protocol/configuration tests cover the non-Mac path; native Windows VPN and BuildKit execution remain unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #210: macOS: containers report hundreds of GB of block reads while the guest has no page cache
tasks.remaining: The balloon reserves active and mapped file cache, holds capacity for 30 seconds after pressure or substantial refaults, and bounds gradual shrinking. Policy and protocol regressions cover these decisions. Native Mac VM cache retention, block-I/O rates, and throughput remain unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #218: Windows: publishing a port on a host IP (-p IP:port:port) fails with 'Address not available (os error 99)'; 0.0.0.0 is loopback-only
tasks.remaining: Implemented the report's clear-limitation alternative: explicit non-loopback Windows host-IP publishing is rejected, while wildcard bindings return a WSL/Windows-LAN warning. Portable address tests cover the policy; no Windows forwarding or firewall rules are installed and native LAN reachability remains unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #225: Windows: Docker API ignores Connection: close, so a body-less 204 (container start) hangs Testcontainers for .NET
tasks.remaining: Existing HTTP connection-close and Windows byte-mode pipe checks remain applicable; changed public #259 has identical source blobs to the already reviewed port. Exact Testcontainers for .NET/SQL Server and the newly mentioned macOS HTTP client still need end-to-end qualification.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #226: Colima vs Kiri vs Podman
tasks.remaining: Dev.100 main comparison 43827712984 and final PR50 comparison 43831181768 each passed 6000 independently verified samples and 15 median/p95 results. Main publication now requires its exact-commit comparison automatically. The runs used different hosts; their timing difference is not a controlled code regression result. Native Mac/Colima/WSL and general application throughput remain unmeasured.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #228: Linux: `docker network create` without an explicit subnet always fails with "no free subnet left" (breaks kind)
tasks.remaining: The new comment's explicit /1 routes both use a gateway; current on_link_routes excludes those routes and retains real connected subnets, with a regression covering both /1 halves. Public Moby v28.0.4 also reserves on-link routes rather than every routed destination. This does not prove the exact CachyOS/VPN environment or every IPv6 and gateway-free tunnel configuration.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #245: docker cp can't read files inside a named volume (breaks Supabase CLI 3 restart)
tasks.remaining: Stopped/created-container mount-aware archive tests exist. Verify the newly reported copy-in certificate holder and Supabase CLI 3 rollback paths, including labels and read-only mounts, on the actual affected platforms.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #247: Bridge containers have no outbound TCP/UDP when host FORWARD policy is DROP (no accept or MASQUERADE rules for kiri0)
tasks.remaining: The new report demonstrates a foreign FORWARD policy-drop chain overriding a separate accept chain. Verify coexistence and useful diagnostics without silently rewriting another firewall or Docker's policy.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #248: Removing a network leaks its DNS listener: next network on the same subnet fails with 'dns bind: Address in use'
tasks.remaining: Owned failed-start DNS/link cleanup, unaffected peers, subnet reuse and actual init descriptor/stdin/EOF tests pass. Public #363's extra descriptor-close proposal is already covered by Asagiri's checked pre-filter close_range and bounded fallback. The reporter's exact kernel 7.3 gateway-address failure remains unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #250: macOS: launching Kiri from Finder/Dock exits silently (open returns 0), and the log records command="" instead of what failed
tasks.remaining: Pure filesystem tests reproduce and fix dangling and unreadable shell-profile failures; command-label and setup-context tests cover diagnostics. The exact reported Finder/Dock failure, LaunchAgent creation and native error alert require a disposable Mac desktop account and remain unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #251: AppImage or Flatpak Version
tasks.remaining: Native x86_64/aarch64 AppImages are released and checked for extraction, CLI/library identity and headless GTK launch. Host GTK/WebKit dependencies and real desktop/FUSE behavior remain; no Flatpak is implemented.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #252: Linux: 0.2.0 .deb fails to install on Ubuntu 22.04 (requires libc6 >= 2.39)
tasks.remaining: GNU Linux package and ELF-baseline checks passed in v0.1.13 qualification. Actual Ubuntu 22.04 GUI installation with its GTK/WebKit packages remains a native desktop check.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #257: GET /distribution/{name}/json is missing, so image-update checks in Docker tools fail
tasks.remaining: Final PR50 passed required live registry metadata/authentication and Docker-reference checks, retaining the Basic-auth error distinction. Actual Watchtower and Arcane applications remain unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #261: Linux: bridge containers can't reach Tailscale/VPN networks (NAT only on default-route NIC, bridges in no firewalld zone)
tasks.remaining: Verify policy-routed full-tunnel VPN and Calico egress, fallback behavior and routed container ingress. Do not infer foreign-firewall compatibility from a default-route network test.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #266: kiri import --list fails on a fresh machine when the default source context does not exist
tasks.remaining: Reviewed import/source detection, argument handling and Windows WSL distro selection are in the candidate and pass portable/topic CI checks. Fresh-machine and real Windows Docker Desktop data migration remain unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #268: [Bug] Docker image/container import fails on Windows
tasks.remaining: Reviewed import/source detection, argument handling and Windows WSL distro selection are in the candidate and pass portable/topic CI checks. Fresh-machine and real Windows Docker Desktop data migration remain unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #269: Windows: expose the engine socket to other WSL distros (WSL integration)
tasks.remaining: Opt-in socket integration with other WSL distros is not implemented. It needs explicit distro/group ownership, persistent restart behavior, scoped bind-path semantics and native WSL tests; the API is not exposed over unauthenticated TCP.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #277: Windows: containers fail on a stock WSL2 — Kiri Linux boots a hybrid cgroup tree, so kiri-init exits 1
tasks.remaining: Asagiri has explicit cgroup delegation/startup and WSL bridge recovery checks. The exact hybrid-tree WSL host remains a native qualification gap; do not infer its result from the Linux fixtures or change another distro's controllers.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #281: [Windows] RTL languages (Arabic and Persian) cause blank UI after restart
tasks.remaining: RTL/browser and all translation checks pass, including the Persian wording update. They cannot reproduce WebView2 startup after a native Windows quit/relaunch. The blank-window report remains open for native investigation.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #288: Dockerfile build fails with 101: Network is unreachable
tasks.remaining: The new build-fails/pull-succeeds comment does not contain enough independent evidence to establish the exact failure cause. Retain the existing BuildKit checks and the unresolved application/host qualification.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #294: Embedded DNS answers from the first-joined network, so Compose service aliases resolve to another project's container
tasks.remaining: Adapted the public DNS ordering fix and retained routed/internal/gateway-family precedence per container. All 17 actual DNS unit tests, including six new regressions, passed on the integrated aarch64 guest; x86_64 also compiled. The 25-case Docker/Asagiri API fixture is checked in and awaits final CI qualification. Explicit gateway priority, Swarm and complete application-level coverage remain outside these tests.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #297: Windows: setup fails with WSL_E_WSL_OPTIONAL_COMPONENT_REQUIRED - the "Subsystem for Linux" optional component is never enabled
tasks.remaining: The setup follow-up handles missing WSL components and build-distro selection with portable/Windows CI coverage. Actual optional-feature enablement, reboot and first launch on native Windows remain unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #303: Trust the system certificate store for registries (corporate root CA, UnknownIssuer)
tasks.remaining: Review native/platform trust-store use across registry, update, share and tools clients, including SSL_CERT_FILE and proxy roots, with a controlled TLS server.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #310: Files changed on the Mac send no inotify events into containers (hot reload doesn't fire)
tasks.remaining: Final PR50 Platform and independently checked ARM64/x86_64 QEMU fsnotify/loop tests passed. Packaged native Mac save-to-inotify/hot-reload remains required after release.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #311: Linux: immediate docker exec fails with unknown user after starting a container with a fresh named volume
tasks.remaining: Native dev.99 and both Docker/private Asagiri in final PR50 Platform passed three fresh 128 MiB volumes, six immediate explicit/inherited image-user execs, a missing-user control and eight owned removals per engine. Existing 20-exec/100-tmpfs readiness checks remain. The reporter's exact Ubuntu ARM host remains unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #315: Support macOS 13 (Ventura): 0.2.1 x86_64 app requires macOS 14 even though the binary targets 10.12
tasks.remaining: The Mac bundle minimum remains macOS 14. A CLI deployment target alone does not prove the Virtualization.framework/AppKit APIs work on Ventura. Intel macOS 13 VM, bind and port tests have not run, so the plist floor was not lowered.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #316: guest stopped before connecting: Some("the agent exited: exit status: 1")
tasks.remaining: Startup/console diagnostics and optional-log failures have reviewed fixes; the report's cgroup/WSL root cause overlaps #277. The exact native failure and improved end-user cause propagation still need verification.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #319: Mac: containers can't reach hosts behind a split-tunnel VPN
tasks.remaining: A Mac host relay or equivalent split-tunnel VPN integration is not implemented or qualified. IPv4/IPv6 localhost checks do not establish private VPN reachability, and the host PF policy was left intact.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #323: Install through homebrew
tasks.remaining: The new Homebrew comments concern an external tap, upstream repository-age policy and zap behavior. No Homebrew publication, uninstall or reinstall has been performed during this review.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #324: Linux: a signal can reach a reused process ID after a container exits
tasks.remaining: Owned-cgroup shutdown and process lookup are in v0.1.13 with Linux checks. Old kernels, adversarial PID churn and exclusion of an external privileged migrator remain outside the demonstrated scope.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #326: Adjust swap memory
tasks.remaining: Per-container MemorySwap limits are implemented and tested. A configurable macOS guest swap allocation is a different feature and is not implemented or benchmarked.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #329: Support insecure-registries (plain-HTTP and self-signed private registries), and read Docker's daemon.json
tasks.remaining: Released daemon.json and scoped HTTP/self-signed registry policy pass private pull/push/TLS and real BuildKit checks. Authority/CIDR and separate worker trust limits are documented; the exact reporter's native environment remains unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #330: Linux: containers have no DNS on the default bridge; Compose/BuildKit builds can't resolve a digest-pinned base; bun install gets ConnectionRefused
tasks.remaining: Existing default-bridge DNS and BuildKit evidence is retained. The exact Bun/Compose application and new default-bridge UDP report remain unqualified. Public #366's shared-network alias ordering has a separate uncommitted candidate with six unit tests and 25 paired fixture cases prepared but not executed.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #336: Windows: would you consider a libkrun/WHP VM backend instead of a WSL 2 distro?
tasks.remaining: A libkrun/WHP backend is an architectural proposal, not an implemented Windows backend. Kernel, storage, networking, memory reclamation and Windows Arm behavior require a separate implementation and native validation.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #337: macOS 26: Cannot move the window
tasks.remaining: The reported macOS 26 window-border dragging behavior has not been reproduced in a native AppKit interaction. Browser geometry and traffic-light tests do not establish window movement.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #338: Can't execute commands properly inside built in container terminal
tasks.remaining: Review #498's per-command result ownership and one-command-at-a-time behavior. Verify clear/late replies and keep one-shot command execution distinct from an interactive terminal.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #340: Unable to copy & paste anything from/to textfield in setting panel
tasks.remaining: Current main has the translated native Mac Edit menu. The new public #352 followup also removes duplicate page-side Mac copying; nine headless cases across three platform modes pass. Actual packaged AppKit clipboard shortcuts remain unverified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #342: Manage compose yamls in Kiri dashboard
tasks.remaining: A dashboard that creates/imports and stores Compose projects is a feature proposal. The existing Compose client/runtime and new health fixture do not implement project-file management.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #344: macOS 14 (Apple silicon): every linux/amd64 container aborts with Rosetta "Failed to find vdso DT_HASH"
tasks.remaining: The report concerns macOS 14 Rosetta requiring the ARM vDSO DT_HASH table, distinct from the earlier auxiliary-vector fix. The proposed dual hash-table kernel change has not been implemented or tested on that OS/Rosetta version; current cross-architecture checks do not prove it.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #345: kiri import copies a volume while a running container is writing to it, and reports done
tasks.remaining: Source writer-state guards and the source-bound migration fixture have release qualification. Writers must remain stopped throughout copying; dependency/retry and metadata fidelity remain tracked under #375/#376/#377/#485.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #346: `/info` returns an empty `SystemTime`, which breaks attached `docker compose up` and `docker compose logs -f` on Compose 5.7+
tasks.remaining: The daemon returns RFC3339Nano SystemTime and v0.1.13 Linux CI passes daemon-time and Compose health/build/wait checks. Actual attached compose up and logs -f event subscriptions still need a dedicated positive check.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #349: Setup fails with "no account named <user>" for directory (non-/etc/passwd) users
tasks.remaining: Asagiri now has bounded reentrant NSS lookups and GNU Linux packaging. Qualify a real directory-account provider and ongoing authorization/revocation on the reported host.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #350: macOS: while the VM runs, host traffic loses the DF bit (pf 'scrub ... no-df' on the primary NIC), breaking large TLS 1.3 ClientHellos on some networks
tasks.remaining: The reported macOS InternetSharing no-df effect and large TLS 1.3 ClientHello loss on the corporate path remain unverified. Container network tests do not cover host-wide PF normalization. No PF, MTU, TLS-security or network-control bypass was applied.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #354: UI: squircle corners, rounded font and flat neutral palette (proposal)
tasks.remaining: The palette/font/squircle redesign is a proposal. Its narrow update-card button clipping and diagnostics-log column squeezing are separate usability defects still needing reproduction and responsive fixes; headless logic tests do not prove native layout.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #355: Settings → Storage: choose where Kiri keeps images, containers and volumes (for example an external drive)
tasks.remaining: Storage relocation UI, sparse cross-volume migration, rollback, missing-drive behavior, shared-data locking and platform-specific WSL/Linux storage movement are not implemented by this review. User data was preserved in place; no USB or external-drive experiment was performed.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #356: macOS on Apple silicon: `--gpus all` as a private channel to a GPU server on the Mac
tasks.remaining: The proposed Apple GPU/MLX relay is not implemented or benchmarked here. Current GPU requests remain visibly unsupported. A per-container host-socket relay needs its own authorization, isolation, lifecycle and cross-platform design and tests.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #358: e2e has no checks for healthchecks, Compose depends_on conditions, up --wait or up --build
tasks.remaining: v0.1.13 Linux CI passes healthchecks and Compose health/build/wait fixtures. Earlier native health evidence remains dated; full native Mac/WSL Compose qualification remains open.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #359: 有新版本推送（0.2.1），我下载之后我选择了立即重启，但是立即重启之后一致循环一下的页面
tasks.remaining: Mac v0.1.13 manual activation and inventory preservation passed. The reported Windows update/restart popup loop still needs a native Windows old-to-new installation test.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #362: Workload numbers on Apple silicon (Kiri 0.2.1 vs OrbStack), and the three "target" rows
tasks.remaining: The reported Kiri/OrbStack Mac workloads used unequal VM resources and are not controlled Asagiri rankings. Asagiri retains its own source-bound 6000-sample Linux comparison. Published 837d994bca94 fixes Hyperfine 2 wall-clock parsing in all three legacy scripts and corrects decimal MB/s for the one-GiB bind workload. Seven parser/report tests pass using an actual official 2.0.0 sleep export, a synthetic legacy record and invalid inputs. This is parser qualification; legacy engine workload cleanup and native Mac application performance remain unqualified.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #365: Unable to mount folders outside $HOME
tasks.remaining: The report concerns macOS mounts outside the user's home. No exact native reproduction or new mount-access fix has been performed; preserve the Apple/platform scope constraint.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #367: Mac: containers have no working HTTP/HTTPS when a security network extension is active (DNS answers 198.18.x, TCP reset)
tasks.remaining: A corporate network extension changes DNS answers to 198.18.x and resets HTTP/TLS. The exact extension and host environment are unverified; no PF, TLS interception or host-security changes are made.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #368: macOS: setting to stop the engine when Kiri quits
tasks.remaining: Stopping the engine when the macOS UI quits is a feature request. The public maintainer's request to another contributor does not authorize agent messages or changes to the user's running engine.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #369: docker command not bindend to kiri
tasks.remaining: The Windows UI reports Asagiri selected while the Docker CLI still uses Desktop. Windows context selection and the exact installed CLI configuration still require targeted source review and runtime qualification.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #370: Non-root container with a missing WorkingDir fails to start (os error 2); breaks DDEV
tasks.remaining: v0.1.13 Linux CI passes start-exec-image-user, including the container-root working-directory setup. Native NFS permission transitions and the exact Mac DDEV report remain separate checks.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #375: kiri import: containers using --network container:<id> fail with "conflicting options: hostname and the network mode" and drop container options
tasks.remaining: Confirmed in import source: network container:<source-id> is not remapped and Hostname is copied into that incompatible mode. Devices, Dns, PidMode, GroupAdd and Healthcheck are also omitted from copied container options. Network dependency remapping and option-preservation fixtures remain unfinished.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #376: kiri import: volume import fails when source lacks 5 hardcoded helper images, and container import leaves empty volumes marked "Already in Kiri"
tasks.remaining: Confirmed in source: volume copying depends on one of five already-present helper images, while a failed volume copy does not stop later dependent container imports. Empty target volumes can then look imported. Preserve the existing source-read-only and idle-volume checks when adding dependency failure handling and retry evidence.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #377: kiri import: containers using digest-pinned untagged images (repo@sha256:...) fail with "No such image"
tasks.remaining: Confirmed in source: untagged images are filtered from import inventory, and container recreation retains Config.Image even when a saved/loaded digest reference is unavailable. Content-verified source-to-destination image mapping and digest-only migration regressions remain unfinished.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #378: Engine: --security-opt systempaths=unconfined is ignored, breaking bubblewrap (bwrap) inside non-privileged containers
tasks.remaining: The reported systempaths=unconfined option is not handled and non-privileged process-path hardening is unconditional. Targeted option semantics and isolation regressions remain unfinished; no broad security bypass is added.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #379: Please add docker-credential-osxkeychain
tasks.remaining: Public comments report a missing docker-credential-osxkeychain helper and a package-manager workaround. Helper bundling and native credential-store behavior have not been independently qualified; no helper was installed on the user's machine.

tasks.title: Verify Kiri #381: macOS: no IPv4 default route when an internal network occupies eth0
